fields.title: Blocks
fields.description: List of blocks that represent this POI in a world. Care should be taken to select blocks that will be rare/infrequent in the world.

fields.title: Tags
fields.description: List of tags for the POI. Tags are used to indicate functionality. E.g. minecraft:bee_home is used to indicate a valid block for a bee's home

fields.title: Tickets
fields.description: The number of entities that can reserve a POI of this type.

fields.title: Usable Distance
fields.description: Represents the general distnace that this POI should be usable from
